'''Pastav Rone''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as part of [[Twin Suns Squadron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He fought at [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] but was injured during the initial skirmish to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He recovered, however, and later returned to the fray.
